purpose: Independent model-level checks; not repository conformance tests.

checks.name: projection_must_retain_join_key
checks.scope: Count-valued bag, equality join, final projection. This refutes only the bad rewrite dropping correlation keys.

checks.name: existence_semijoin_is_not_weighted_join
checks.scope: Chosen existence-guard profile only; does not assert the intended semantics of every Gift semijoin.

checks.name: finite_carrier_not_finite_weighted_fixed_point
checks.scope: One-tuple equations x=1+x over N and x=True OR x over Bool. Nonexistence of a finite N solution follows algebraically, not from bounded sampling.

checks.name: min_deletion_requires_support
checks.scope: Deleting a minimum requires remaining support or recomputation, not subtraction from the old minimum.

checks.name: zero_weight_cannot_erase_invalid_source
checks.scope: The model requires all supplied facts to be typed before zero elimination; no existing implementation is executed.

checks.name: exact_rational_not_host_float
checks.scope: Only illustrates that a rational profile needs an exact target representation; does not benchmark target backends.

checks.name: same_value_new_dependency
checks.scope: May avoid downstream value recomputation, but must update the query dependency set for later changes.

checks.name: publication_basis_guard
checks.scope: Exhaustive truth table for a two-field equality guard only; not a proof of real concurrent publication, IPC or filesystem atomicity.
